description: Echo UI acceptance criteria, including the approved app-wide Balanced Canvas direction

phase3f.note: Phase 3F acceptance runs per task with the task's FOCUSED_SUITE plus cumulative EchoTests, Release simulator/device builds and static/privacy/model/compliance gates (execution plan §6.1). No existing threshold is lowered.

fixed_delivery_approval.description: Agent navigates Simulator to contract-specified UI state, stops interaction, user inspects directly

surface_family_rules.description: Discovery rich-data defaults to adaptive masonry with low-data/accessibility fallback; Focus/Task remain no-masonry

balanced_canvas.description: Home validates 0 with active scan, 0 without scan/authorization, 1-19 and 20-plus displayable states; Search validates below 6, at-least-6 scanEligible majority, tie and continuousReading majority; scanEligible text is a trimmed 1...160 Swift Character summary; masonry additionally requires non-Accessibility Dynamic Type, VoiceOver off and at least 340pt content width; only policy-allowed source-resolvable items count and semantic order is stable

discovery_truthfulness.description: Production Discovery uses no fixture or fake progress; scan UI requires a real active ProgressActor task; suggestions carry executable SearchPipeline payloads gated by current capabilities

discovery_gestures.description: Generic Home/Search cards have no horizontal swipe; the US-AWK-005 awakening-card variant provides left-next/right-record-feeling plus equivalent visible and accessibility actions

app_wide_visual_profile.description: Every AppShell/Home/Search/Detail/Settings/Onboarding/Awakening/BackgroundTask/Creation/Degradation/ResumeProgress/Translation surface uses echo-memory-canvas shared tokens/components while preserving its family layout

warm_accent_pair.description: AccentColor and OnAccentColor use the approved light #A64B32/#FFFFFF and dark #E08A68/#1C1C1E semantic pairs; emphasized actions consume both tokens

per_task.run_with: The current 3F task's FOCUSED_SUITE, run through the complete §6.1 focused command (project + scheme + configuration + destination + serial + exact suite); suite empty, suite not found or executed test count 0 are treated as command failure, not RED
per_task.3f0_exception: 3F.0 is docs-only and has no focused source test; its acceptance is JSON parse plus a before/after policy stop-rule review

cumulative_gates.all_tests: Full serial EchoTests run (xcodebuild test, -parallel-testing-enabled NO, -only-testing:EchoTests)
cumulative_gates.ui_tests: Affected exact EchoUITests/<SuiteName> first, then full EchoUITests
cumulative_gates.privacy_model_compliance: privacy/audit contracts, model provenance/checksum and compliance checks per the task's §4.6 acceptance check

3f11_gate.extra: Full no-fixture, coverage, compliance and signing checks; EchoUITests/Phase3FProductionE2ETests; Release device/simulator evidence
3f11_gate.premerge: 3F.11 PR submits only pre-merge gate evidence; Phase 4 stays locked until human merge

phase3f_acceptance.threshold_policy: No threshold in pr_matrix, nightly_matrix, verification_gates or approval_points is lowered; Phase 3F adds mandatory gates only
